_note: Answer bank the builder draws from. Add entries freely; the solver picks whatever fits a quote. Clues should stay under about 70 characters so they wrap to two lines at most.
_themes: Answers that belong to a theme. Every puzzle is required to use a few of them, which is what keeps a pack feeling like its subject.
_tricky: Answers whose clue is real wordplay or needs a leap. The builder counts these as harder pairs, which is one of the difficulty levers.
